mission: Look at the product list and open a few products. Check that sorting changes the list, that each product has its own picture and description, and that prices agree between the list and the product page.
checklist: Sort by each option (A to Z, Z to A, price low to high, price high to low) and check the list order really changes
Open at least three products and compare the picture, name, description and price with the list
Look for two different products showing the same picture or the same description
